newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges down, traders eye NY expir.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges down, traders eye NY expir.

text.p: London's nearby August white sugar contract formed the focus of a lacklustre early Tuesday session and trading was minimal ahead of the New York open.

Trade activity on either side of the market, which also included some against actuals interest, kept August steady in a tight range although the August/October spread narrowed slightly into $8.50 offered from $9.00.
One leading trade house was reported to be an outright seller of August.
"It's all very quiet and I think a lot of people are just reflecting on the New York market," said one trader.
May raws expires on April 30 and has been the subject of much conjecture in London in recent days, with the origins to be delivered still something of a mystery.
Some traders have also suggested that a large May speculative position is still outstanding.
At 1120 GMT August was down 10 cents at $313.00 and October down 30 cents at $304.50. Volume was almost entirely dominated by August and reached 255 lots.
Just 29 lots of the equivalent August contract were traded on the Paris market. The position was down 30 cents at $313.00.
